description: §41.12.1 rule 5 — a literal registerMessages template that names a slot its variant does not have is refused with E-MESSAGE-SLOT-UNKNOWN. `MinFailed`'s slots are `{field}` and `{threshold}`; `{expected}` belongs to the comparison variants (GtFailed …). The well-formed `.Required` entry beside it fires nothing.
rationale: §41.12.1 rule 3: the slots are `{field}` plus the variant's §55.9 payload field names (MinFailed(threshold: number)). Rule 5: a literal template is parsed against its variant's slot table at compile time; an unknown slot name is E-MESSAGE-SLOT-UNKNOWN. Exactly one diagnostic — one per bad template.
